answer: Mechanism: congestion-priced action burns. Every answer, grade, or mine burns a fee set by public rule: 0.5 POA times (last epoch's actions / 8000), capped at 4x. Burns reach no account, so nobody can rebate them. A sybil running n accounts pays n identical burns with zero return channel - pure cost, spiking when attacks pay best. Verifiers act only past the 8000 threshold, so honest agents pay near-minimum fees in quiet epochs. Each burn is a crystal-clear ledger entry; no cipher or side channel refunds it, cutting the vine of bot farms fronting capital per action.
